# `Web.Console`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Web.Console — types exposed for the optional `consoleAuth`
field on `Web.app` cfg.

The `consoleAuth` callback is row-polymorphic, optional, and has
shape `Request -> Task Error (Maybe Identity)`.  When the framework
gates `/_ipe/console` in `app`-mode (env `IPE_CONSOLE_AUTH=app`),
it invokes the callback per request, BEFORE mounting console
routes.  `Nothing` → 403 + structured `console.auth.denied` audit
log.  `Just identity` → request continues; the identity rides on
the same `__Host-ipe_console` session cookie + is attached to
subsequent telemetry for audit.

Use this when the app already has an SSO / multi-tenant session
middleware: thread it into `consoleAuth` and the embedded console
inherits the same auth surface — no second token to provision.

## `Identity`

Identity returned by the `consoleAuth` callback when access is
permitted. `subject` is the user's stable identifier (GitHub
login / email / database UUID). `email` is surfaced separately
so the audit log line is human-scannable. `claims` carries any
extra attributes the RBAC layer will consult.

## `defaultIdentity`

```ipe
defaultIdentity : String -> Identity
```

`defaultIdentity "user-42"` — Identity with empty email + claims.
Builder chain stays source-compat when future releases add optional fields.

## `withEmail`

```ipe
withEmail : String -> Identity -> Identity
```

`withEmail "alice@example.com" id` — replace the audit email.

## `withClaim`

```ipe
withClaim : String -> String -> Identity -> Identity
```

`withClaim "role" "admin" id` — add a single RBAC claim.

## `withClaims`

```ipe
withClaims : Dict String String -> Identity -> Identity
```

`withClaims (Dict.fromList [("role", "admin"), ("tier", "pro")]) id`
— replace the entire claims Dict at once.
